description: This file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.6.0.1. It extends an abstract migration class and provides methods for applying the migration (which is empty in this case) and retrieving the version number.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class for version 4.6.0.1 of OrangeHRM, extending AbstractMigration and implementing methods to get the version and perform the migration.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Defines the migration actions to be taken when applying this migration. In this case, it does nothing.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.6.0.1' associated with this migration.
